packageRules.description: Traefik feature-set + config schema owned by the catena operator role (roles/traefik); minor/major land via operator converge, not catalog edits.

Postgres is centrally governed: the per-template compose pins must equal the top-level postgres_default_image in source/catalog.yml (build/lint_postgres_pins.py fails the build otherwise). Group EVERY postgres bump -- the docker-compose pins AND the catalog central-default customManager below -- into one reviewed PR so they move together and the lint stays green. A split bump (pins without the default, or vice versa) would redden the PR. automerge off: a Postgres major/minor is a coordinated, reviewed change.

customManagers.description: Track the central Postgres image (postgres_default_image) in sources/_meta.json. The per-template compose pins follow it (enforced by build/lint_postgres_pins.py); the packageRule above groups this bump with the compose-pin bumps into one PR. Was source/catalog.yml (YAML) before the 'one JSON file per template' refactor (1c1f17a) moved this key to sources/_meta.json (JSON) -- this manager pointed at a path that no longer existed and matched nothing since.
